answer: Because the zephyr solution is checked at the ember gate and logged, the echo audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 26 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Each copy needs 3 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
